scope: Public site pages checked through web retrieval. No customer/order data used.

facts.fact: Socialora has a public directory of free creator tools.
The bio tool provides editable bio suggestions from a topic and optional detail.
The safe zone tool provides approximate overlays for Reels, TikTok and Shorts; preview in the app too.
The content ideas tool provides starting formats; the author supplies their own concrete examples.
The photo resizer provides destination sizes and a crop preview.
The no-crop tool fits a photo inside a blurred background.
The video frame tool lets the visitor save a selected video frame as an image.
Order tracking uses the order reference and order email on the website.
The FAQ explains the general ordering process; service terms are specific to the chosen service.
Published support email: info@getsocialora.com. Do not request private order data in the public group.

excluded_from_automatic_posts: Prices, refill periods, delivery time promises, success stories and giveaways
Free views quantities or availability that might change during the 14-day schedule
Claims that any service guarantees followers, safety, rankings, sales or reach
